entry_points.text: Raw CPUID instruction wrapper is the architectural boundary: takes leaf and subleaf via caller memory, executes identification instruction, returns EAX EBX ECX EDX through same memory for reuse by helpers.

exports.text: Header exposes side-effect-free CPUID helpers with no locking: always-true availability check, raw four-register exchange, single-register readers for a leaf, leaf readers with cleared subleaf, and leaf-plus-subleaf array or indexed readers enforcing 16-byte and 4-byte destinations.

hazards.text: Treat inputs as untrusted: leaf2 counts and registers need sanitizing, some parts leave ECX unchanged so preset it, parser may fill only prefix so handle absent entries, descriptor decode needs external table, AMD L3 test is only nonzero check.
Trust-domain and extended-range vendor strings store middle bytes in last word and vice versa; linear register concatenation corrupts them, consumers must reorder by documented ranges.

Bug IDs equal capability-word count times 32 plus index. Indices 0-12 cover legacy faults; 13-25 plus 27-31 cover erratum 400, meltdown spectre store L1TF MDS SWAPGS abort multihit SRBDS MMIO retbleed PBRSB RSB gather TDX with 26 skipped; second word base plus 32 offsets 0-12 cover SRSO div0 RFDS BHI IBPB-no-ret user-Spectre microcode ITS TSA VMSCAPE SEAM TLBI.
Boot CPU flags query is an external dependency owned outside this dossier; this view cites it only as a required query without describing its behavior.

invariants.text: Capability numbers equal word times 32 plus offset. Observed words cover 9 through 21; unlisted offsets in a word are reserved with no capability here. Values are stable identifiers for processor and mitigation support.

Plain and indexed CPUID paths differ. Indexed leaves are 4,7,11,13,15,16,18,20,23,24,29,30,31,36 plus extended topology. Callers clear ECX, raw exchange treats memory as clobbered, paravirt builds redirect generic path while direct readers use raw instruction.
Leaf 2 output is sanitized: count other than one yields empty outputs, each word with invalid marker is cleared independently, descriptor bytes 1-15 translate through shared table.

Parsed CPUID is read via const leaf and subleaf views. Single-entry access requires exactly one fill; indexed access checks first subleaf plus static range size and filled count else yields nothing. Raw views reinterpret as register quadruples; count reports filled indexed entries; AMD L3 presence is nonzero extended leaf 6 EDX.

Each descriptor is four 32-bit words with named partitions; unnamed bits are reserved and ignored. Set bit means present except performance unavailability map where set means absent. Numerics use biased forms: zero-based maxima, minus-one lengths, byte sizes, log2 enclave sizes, 4K-page feedback units.
Enumerable leaves advertise max subleaf or count in base record; software iterates only defined indices. Both CPUID headers use unique include-guard macros making repeat inclusion a no-op.

structs.text: Leaves 0,1,2,4,5,6 describe identity and cache power. Leaf0 holds max standard leaf plus 12-byte vendor split across words. Leaf1 packs stepping model family type, brand flush logical APIC, plus two words of capability bits. Leaf2 holds count plus 15 descriptor bytes with per-word invalid markers. Leaf4 per level subleaf 0-31 gives kind level topology, geometry, sets, hierarchy behavior. Leaf5 gives monitor line sizes, extensions, per-C-state counts. Leaf6 gives thermal power HWP flags, thresholds, frequency bias, feedback sizing and index.

Leaves 7,9,10,11,13 enumerate features, perf, topology, state. Leaf7 base gives subleaf count plus dense protection vector crypto key spec bits; subleaf1 adds vector address compare return MSR string matrix bits; subleaf2 reserves three words with mitigation bits in last. Leaf9 has one firmware bit. Leaf10 gives perf version counters width, unavailability bitmap, fixed bitmap, fixed count width. Leaf11 per domain 0-1 gives shift, logical count, domain number kind, xAPIC ID. Leaf13 base maps user state plus save sizes; subleaf1 gives save ops plus supervisor map; per-component 2-63 gives size, offset, supervisor alignment.

Leaves F,10,12,14 cover QoS, enclave, trace. LeafF base gives max RMID plus LLC-monitor presence; subleaf1 gives counter width overflow, byte factor, max ID, event support. Leaf10 base signals cache bandwidth allocation; per-resource 1-2 gives mask length, unit bitmap, update priority sparse support, max class; subleaf3 gives throttle max, thread linearity, max class. Leaf12 base gives enclave versions ops, exit options, log2 sizes; subleaf1 gives attribute and in-enclave feature maps; per-section 2-31 gives wide base size plus kind type. Leaf14 base gives max subleaf, filter timing packet bits, output schemes; subleaf1 gives address counts and timing bitmaps.

Higher leaves describe time, topology, platform and synthetic state. 0x15 gives ratio and crystal hertz; 0x16 base max bus MHz; 0x17 base max vendor project stepping plus brand continuations 1-3; 0x18 per index 0-31 TLB sizes sharing associativity sets kind; 0x19 key-locker restrictions; 0x1A hybrid model category; 0x1B per index 0-31 config type targets; 0x1C branch-record depth filters logging; 0x1D palette sizes rows tiles; 0x1E matrix height width; 0x1F per index 0-5 shift count level type x2APIC; 0x20 subleaf count plus director reset; 0x21 trust-domain vendor text shuffled; 0x23 perf root counter auto-reload plus events precise maps; 0x40000000 hypervisor max plus provider text; 0x4C780001 two synthetic OS feature pages; 0x4C780002 synthetic bug page; 0x80000000 extended max plus vendor text shuffled.
